record.question: Name the 3D Sanskrit film screened at the international film festival of India?
record.explanation: Answer D: Anurakti. Anurakthi is the Sanskrit film represented at Film Bazaar/IFFI 2017 with a 3 D song/sequence. NFDC’s original 2017 press-coverage archive reproduces the filmmaker interview naming Anurakthi and explaining its 3 D presentation. The option Anurakti is an orthographic variant/misspelling of that title. Historical/source note: The Film Bazaar/IFFI 2017 presentation and 3 D sequence claim; do not imply every frame was stereoscopic or that it was necessarily an official Indian Panorama selection. Reference: https://films.wavesbazaar.com/media/2588/press_coverage_2017.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
